## Summary

Describe the focused change and the problem it solves.

## Verification

- [ ] Added or updated focused regression coverage, or explained why it is not applicable.
- [ ] Ran `npm test`.
- [ ] Ran `npm run test:integration` when browser behavior changed.
- [ ] Ran `npm run pack:check` when package contents or public metadata changed.

## Safety and compatibility

- [ ] Safe mode, remote refusal, and evidence for blocked attempts remain intact.
- [ ] Fixtures use only fake data, localhost, and harmless behavior.
- [ ] Public schemas, TypeScript declarations, CLI help, and docs are synchronized where applicable.
- [ ] The change does not claim certification, browser-vendor affiliation, or containment of hostile code.

## Notes for reviewers

Call out contract-semantic changes, report-shape changes, known limitations, or follow-up work.
